setup_findings: prepare-mcp failed 3 times (owned SSM operation failed) while the guest bootstrap ran, then succeeded at 14:18:53Z, ~5 min after launch

after that, frontend-proxy existed but was not running (port 8090 refused for 15 min); the bootstrap's own docker compose up over SSM (mcp_guest.compose('up','-d','--no-build','--pull','never'), overlay included) started it at ~14:31Z. Likely race between prepare-mcp's --no-deps up and the bootstrap's first up; not diagnosed further

the connect-mcp SSM tunnel ended at 14:43Z ('owned MCP tunnel ended') with no traffic; reconnecting with connect-mcp restored it before the injection. The baseline's rule states were read from Grafana over the separate 8090 tunnel, unaffected

healthy_baseline.warmup_before_window: 4 min, 8 samples; one Pending (ad, service-error-rate) at 14:32:32Z, never fired
